subject: A clear on-page relationship builder for the Threshing Floor, with a selected actor, a verb and multiple target cards.
reader: Parker knows Terminal Delight and supplied the screenshots; he is reviewing the proposed interaction and appearance before the native build.

sections.heading: Relationship builder
sections.text:
In Terminal Delight, relationships control which agent can see, read, ask or prompt another. Your screenshots show a form that hides who is acting on whom. This builder puts the actor, verb and target cards in one sentence. 

 Interactive sketch Native implementation pending

sections.heading: Draw the connection
sections.text:
Connect and both drag gestures open this builder. Alt-drag draws a line while the actor card stays in place. 

 02 · Release on the target 

 Connect Selected card → actor 
 Card onto card Dragged card → actor; hit card → target 
 Alt + left drag Draw line → release on target 

 All three entry paths open the same on-page builder. A card hit wins over the org background around it. A self-drop, an outside drop or Escape changes nothing. Ordinary membership drops keep their current destinations. This drawing specifies the gesture; native event verification comes during the build.

sections.heading: Save together
sections.text:
Review the targets together, then apply one verb to the whole set. 

 03 · One choice, three relationships 

HISTORY ACTOR 

CAN READ → 

codex 
REVIEW 
RUNNER 

 All targets present Save all three directed relationships. 
 A target disappeared Keep the draft and name the missing card. Save none. 
 A line already exists Show that it will change to the chosen verb before Save. 

 The batch is validated before any relationship changes. Each target receives its own saved line, using the existing line store. A target removed before Save prevents the whole batch. Editing an existing line keeps one fixed target and its Remove action. This is proposed behavior; persistence and access tests are still pending.

sections.heading: Review
sections.text:
Comment on a picture or concur with these behavior choices. 

 One verb for the set 
Recommended: apply the chosen verb to every listed target, including existing relationships named in the summary. A missing target stops the entire save. 

 Show all eligible cards 
Recommended: show the current org's available cards even when the board is filtered. Changing actor keeps the other targets and removes any self-target. 
 Implementation and proof 

The native build will route card and connector gestures into the same builder, validate every selected target, then update the saved relationships together. 
Native checks cover gestures, batch saves, restoration and access revocation. The existing saved line format stays.
